ns2:course.label: Facilities Planning and Design
ns2:course.description: Facility planning, plant layout design, and materials handling analysis; determination of facilities requirements, site selection, materials flow, use of analytical and computerized techniques including simulation, and applications to areas such as manufacturing, warehousing, and office planning. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent enrollment in IE 310.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent enrollment in IE 310.
